worldcombat.skill.tackle.summary: Build into a short run in a chosen direction, strike with your whole body, then slide off to the side as the momentum fades; you can pick a direction and charge into empty space. Speed and weight make the hit heavier; a miss carries you to the end of the charge.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.use.0: A short run-up slam in any direction
worldcombat.skill.tackle.use.1: Shove a foe off its cover for a step
worldcombat.skill.tackle.use.2: Slide sideways after contact to adjust your position
worldcombat.skill.tackle.description.0: The slam deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.description.1: Charge up to %1$s blocks, building to at most %2$s blocks per tick; contact leads into four slowing steps that slide about %3$s blocks to the target's side. A miss reaches the end of the charge; obstacles stop either movement early.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.description.2: A landed hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks along the charge.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.runUp.on: Run-up form: a longer charge and side-slip with slightly more power, at the cost of a longer preparation, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.runUp.off: Close form: quicker to come out and steadier on your feet, with a shorter charge and side-slip and slightly less power.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.growth.0: At level %1$s, Tackle power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.growth.1: At level %1$s, Tackle power rises to %2$s and the charge to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.preference.runU: On: longer charge and side-slip with slightly more power, but a longer recovery and cooldown and you overrun further on a miss. Off: a close body check, quick to come out and steady on your feet.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of charging. Larger values chase harder and overrun further behind the target on a miss.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.preference.ai.f: On: prefer this hit when the target is below three tenths health. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
worldcombat.skill.tackle.preference.ai.l: On: it will leave its station under a hold order to charge. Off: it only charges when the target is already in reach.
